thread:
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone — starting a follow-up thread from the all-hands Q&A specifically for questions about hub access, travel, and offsites. Drop short follow-ups and we'll triage.

Tom (Eng): Quick one — if I want to work from the SF hub for a week, do I need to book ahead and how far out?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes please book at least 48 hours ahead so facilities can confirm desk/meeting room availability. Use the Office Hub booking page: https://intranet.redwood/office-hubs (booking opens 60 days out).

Liz (Design): Visitor policy — can I bring a contractor for a day? Do they need NDA/escort?

Aisha (People Ops): Contractors/guests need an approved visitor pass. Short visits (<=4 hours) can be approved by your manager; for full-day or repeated access we need a sponsor + signed vendor NDA. Facilities may require an escort depending on building rules.

Sanjay (EM): Offsite planning: is there a standard per-person cap for two-day offsites? Also who approves meals > $100?

Devon (Finance): We have an internal guideline: $250 per person per day is the default cap for US offsites (includes meals + shared venue costs). Anything above requires People Ops + Finance pre-approval. Submit via the Offsite Request form: https://intranet.redwood/offsites and include an estimated budget.

Tom (Eng): International travel — visa/immigration support? We have a contractor needing a letter for visa processing.

Aisha (People Ops): We can issue a support letter for employees; contractors require the vendor team to provide documentation. Please DM me the details (dates, purpose, country) and we'll route to Legal if needed.

Liz (Design): Expense system note — are we still using Ramp for card expenses and Concur for reimbursements? I saw both mentioned in the playbook.

Devon (Finance): Ramp for company cards and day-to-day spend. Concur for personal card reimbursements and travel bookings that require statement uploads. Short tip: attach itemized receipts to the Concur claim to speed approvals.

HR-Bot: People Ops handbook updated: "Workstyle & Hub Access" section edited at 1803001200. Link: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/workstyle (search 'hub access').

Sanjay (EM): Related — parking/commute stipend: are we continuing the monthly commuter allowance for hybrid folks?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — commuter stipend continues for eligible roles. If you changed office/home location this quarter, submit an update via the Payroll portal so allowances are recalculated.

Tom (Eng): Reimbursements turnaround time? Had one pending for 12 business days.

Devon (Finance): Standard is 7–10 business days once all receipts are attached and the claim is approved by the manager. If it's >10, ping me directly with the claim ID and I'll escalate.

Liz (Design): Is there any guidance on booking flexible vs refundable fares for offsites? Managers sometimes prefer cheaper non-refundable to save budget.

Aisha (People Ops): We recommend refundable fares for trips > $1,000 or where dates may change. For smaller domestic trips, non-refundable is fine but please include contingency in the offsite budget. If the trip is high-variance, flag it in the Offsite Request so Finance notes the risk.

Tom (Eng): Thanks — last one: badge access after hours? I have an odd schedule sometimes.

Aisha (People Ops): After-hours access is allowed but you must register the hours on the Access Portal for security. If you need permanent after-hours access, manager should request a badge permission change.

Sanjay (EM): Awesome thread — can we pin the Offsite Request and handbook links to the #people-ops channel?

Aisha (People Ops): Done :thumbsup: pinned the Offsite Request form and handbook link. We'll consolidate answers into the handbook and announce edits in next week's update.

Tom (Eng): Great, thanks everyone!

Liz (Design): Super helpful, appreciate it.

HR-Bot: Reminder: submit any outstanding travel claims within 30 days of travel to avoid denied reimbursement.

Aisha (People Ops): Closing the loop — if you need one-off help (visa letters, large budget approvals), DM me and we'll set a quick 15-min slot.
